layout.name: Simple Pie Chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	3D : "true";
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border12";
	header : "@#label9";
	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.slice1.label") #>";
	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.slice2.label") #>";
	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.slice3.label") #>";
	legendPosition : "South";
	legendVisible : "true";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "200,175";
	sampleSeries[0] : "Pie_Chart_Data,15,60,25:PIE";
	type : "PIE";
}

chart3DView {
	depth : "15";
	rotation : "-420.0";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	border : "@#border11";
	followChartResize : "true";
	paintingBackground : "false";
	title : "OFF";
}

point {
	color2 : "#ff000000";
	stroke : "@=stroke1";
}

point[index=="0"] {
	color1 : "@=color2";
}

point[index=="1"] {
	color1 : "@=color3";
}

point[index=="2"] {
	color1 : "@=color4";
}

series[index="0"] {
	annotation : "@#labelAnno5";
	explodedSegments : "30.0,0.0,0.0";
	labeling : "Percent";
	labelLayout : "Centered";
}

Subobject#border10 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#border11 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border12 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border8 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#color2 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#FFdc143c";
	colors[1] : "#FFffc0cb";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}

Subobject#color3 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#FF87C0E8";
	colors[1] : "#FFC5DFF4";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}

Subobject#color4 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#FFFEC658";
	colors[1] : "#FFFEEDCC";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}

Subobject#label7 {
	border : "@#border8";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label9 {
	border : "@#border10";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimplePie.header") #>";
}

Subobject#labelAnno5 {
	class : "ilog.views.chart.graphic.IlvDataLabelAnnotation(labelRenderer)";
	labelRenderer : "@#labelRenderer6";
}

Subobject#labelRenderer6 {
	class : "ilog.views.chart.IlvLabelRenderer";
	color : "#ff000000";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
}

Subobject#stroke1 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "0";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
